purpose: Teach: 神経質/奪い/無駄遣い/辛口/刃物/利い/ろくに/使い道

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、神経質だよね、本当に、いつも、心配してくれて、感謝してる、絶対。
lines.en: Mom, Dad — he worries a lot, doesn't he? I'm really grateful for that. I mean it.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine observation. Sho speaking without performance — almost thinking aloud. Soft certainty in 'grateful.' No rush.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お友達、玩具を、奪い取らないでね、翔くん、優しく、貸してあげようね、約束ね、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. And when you play with your friends, be gentle with their toys, okay? Share nicely. That's our promise.
lines.style: Warm, teaching-tone but not lecturing. Yumiko speaking as she guides — matter-of-fact kindness. Light emphasis on 'our promise' — affirming, not stern.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お小遣い、無駄遣いしないって、ぼく、ママに、約束したよね、ちゃんと、貯金してるよ、本当に。
lines.en: I promised you I wouldn't waste my allowance, right? I'm saving it properly. Really.
lines.style: Small pride underneath. Sho reporting honestly — not bragging, just wanting her to know he kept his word. Steady delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、辛口カレー、本気で、好きなのよね、翔くんは、まだ、甘口ね、約束ね、絶対。
lines.en: Your father loves his spicy curry, you know. But you're still on mild — and that's fine. That's the agreement.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost affectionate. Yumiko noticing the small difference between father and son without making it matter. Accepting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、刃物、ぼく、絶対、触らないからね、約束、本当に、安心して、絶対、ね。
lines.en: Mom, I won't touch sharp things. I promise. You don't have to worry. I really mean it.
lines.style: Serious, reassuring — the careful sincerity of a child wanting to be trusted. Each phrase lands. Earnest without being heavy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの、ぴりっと利いた、ジョーク、家族で、笑ったわね、翔くん、覚えてる?
lines.en: Your grandfather's jokes — do you remember? That sharp one? The whole family laughed so hard.
lines.style: Affectionate recall. Yumiko's voice softens thinking back — almost nostalgic. Inviting Sho into the memory with her. Gentle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、ろくに、勉強しないと、ダメだよね、ママ、本気で、頑張るからね、絶対、約束、本当に。
lines.en: I can't just not study, right? I'm going to work hard for real. I promise. I mean it.
lines.style: Determined but young — Sho making a sincere vow to himself as much as to her. Quiet conviction. No artificial intensity.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お年玉、何に、使い道、決めた?翔くん、ママ、本当に、楽しみよ、絶対、聞かせてね、絶対。
lines.en: Have you decided what you want to do with your New Year money? I'm really curious to hear. Tell me?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Yumiko leaning in — not prying, but wanting to know what matters to him. Invitation, not interrogation.
